entries.symptom: Error reading Expo config: SyntaxError: Unexpected token (or ERR_UNKNOWN_FILE_EXTENSION ".ts") while loading app.config.ts or metro.config.js
entries.cause: Node runs without type stripping (NODE_OPTIONS=--no-strip-types, or Node older than 22.18), so app.config.ts and the .ts helpers metro.config.js requires cannot load
entries.fix: Use Node 22.18 or newer (projects pin 26 in .nvmrc and engines); never set --no-strip-types; an eas.json build profile that pins an older "node" breaks EAS builds the same way

entries.symptom: Error reading Expo config ... Cannot find module './src/config/app-variant' (a relative import from app.config.ts)
entries.cause: Node type stripping resolves files exactly as written: an extensionless relative import is not found
entries.fix: Write the extension in every relative import of app.config.ts ('./src/config/app-variant.ts'); the tsconfig needs allowImportingTsExtensions and erasableSyntaxOnly

entries.symptom: Warning MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON when Node runs a .ts script
entries.cause: An ESM .ts file loads from a folder whose nearest package.json has no "type": "module"; the app root cannot set it while metro.config.js is CommonJS
entries.fix: Keep scripts/package.json with {"type": "module"} for the Node-run tooling; a script that imports app files may pass --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON (harmless)

entries.symptom: EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_VARIANT=<x> must equal APP_VARIANT=<y>: the JS bundle and the native app must agree
entries.cause: Only one of the two variant variables was exported, or they were exported with different values
entries.fix: Export APP_VARIANT and EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_VARIANT with the same value once for the whole run (an eas.json profile env sets both)

entries.symptom: APP_VARIANT and EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_VARIANT are not set: production bundles and EAS builds name their variant
entries.cause: A production export or an EAS build ran without a variant; the resolver refuses to guess, because a silent development default would ship test code
entries.fix: Set both variables in the eas.json profile env or export them for the local build; never default the resolver to production or development
match: APP_VARIANT and EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_VARIANT are not set

entries.symptom: A production bundle still contains test-only code, or shows the development variant, right after a development build on the same machine
entries.cause: Metro inlines EXPO_PUBLIC_* values at transform time but does not key its cache on them, and the cache (metro-cache in the system temp folder) is shared by every build on the machine
entries.fix: Set config.cacheVersion from the public values in metro.config.js (publicEnvCacheVersion(process.env)); prove it with a development build followed by a production export of the same tree. Never delete the cache instead: it hides the missing key until the next build

entries.symptom: A test-only module is still in the production bundle although it is gated by a constant such as IS_TEST_BUILD
entries.cause: Metro removes a require() only when the literal process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_VARIANT comparison sits in the same expression; an imported constant, a helper call, __DEV__ or an if block does not fold
entries.fix: Reach test-only code only through src/test-only.ts: process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_VARIANT === 'production' ? null : require('./test-only-entry')

entries.symptom: The built app reports another variant than requested (Constants.expoConfig.extra or the bundle disagree with the native identity)
entries.cause: The variables were set for the prebuild but not for xcodebuild or Gradle, whose bundle phase and config evaluation run the config again with their own environment
entries.fix: Build one environment and pass it to every step (the build scripts and EAS profiles do); never prebuild in one shell and build in another

entries.symptom: Setting process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_* inside app.config.ts has no effect on the JS bundle
entries.cause: Metro bundles later (the Xcode build phase, the Gradle bundle task or the EAS worker) in its own process and environment
entries.fix: Export the variable for the whole build (eas.json profile env, or the build script); app.config.ts only reads and checks it

entries.symptom: Crash at launch mentioning GADApplicationIdentifier (iOS) or "Missing application ID" from the Google Mobile Ads SDK (Android)
entries.cause: The ads plugin entry is missing or has no app id for that platform, so the native manifest lacks the id the linked SDK requires at startup
entries.fix: Give react-native-google-mobile-ads' plugin an iosAppId and androidAppId in every variant (Google's sample ids outside production), then prebuild with --clean

entries.symptom: npx expo config or prebuild: Failed to resolve plugin for module "<package>"
entries.cause: app.config.ts lists a config plugin whose package is not installed (often added by hand before npx expo install)
entries.fix: npx expo install <package>, then rerun; a plugin entry and its dependency land in the same commit
match: Failed to resolve plugin for module

entries.symptom: The prebuilt iOS app has no PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy
entries.cause: Expo prebuild writes the app privacy manifest only when the config declares ios.privacyManifests
entries.fix: Declare ios.privacyManifests from the shared PRIVACY_MANIFESTS (required-reason APIs aggregated from the pods), prebuild with --clean

entries.symptom: Prebuild warns: Install expo-system-ui in your project to enable this feature
entries.cause: userInterfaceStyle 'automatic' needs expo-system-ui to apply the theme on Android
entries.fix: npx expo install expo-system-ui, so Android follows the system light or dark setting (knip then sees it through the config)

entries.symptom: Prebuild warns: `edgeToEdgeEnabled` customization is no longer available - Android 16 makes edge-to-edge mandatory
entries.cause: Expo SDK 54 and newer always draw edge to edge on Android; the old opt-out key does nothing
entries.fix: Remove android.edgeToEdgeEnabled from the app config; pad content with safe-area insets on both platforms (verified in @expo/prebuild-config of SDK 57)

entries.symptom: A simulator or emulator build stops with "preflight failed, nothing was built": package.json has no "<script>" script, or the script runs a file that does not exist
entries.cause: The build contract's preflight or postPrebuild list names a script whose tooling is not in the repo yet
entries.fix: Add the script and the tooling it runs (the skill the contract names), then build again; never drop the entry from the contract to start the build

entries.symptom: Release app terminates at launch: Unhandled JS Exception ... AppRegistryBinding::startSurface failed. Global was not installed
entries.cause: reloadAppAsync() ran during bundle evaluation (module scope of the entry or a module it imports), before the runtime was ready
entries.fix: Reload only from a mounted component (a press handler or an effect after the language is saved), through the direction module

entries.symptom: The screenshot is one flat light grey (#F2F2F2)
entries.cause: That is the navigator's default screen background with nothing on it: the screen component rendered nothing (a stub, null, or an error swallowed into an empty view)
entries.fix: Build the screen or fix the error; the build skills flag such a screenshot as blank-screen

entries.symptom: The screenshot is white, black or one flat colour other than the navigator grey
entries.cause: The app crashed at launch or drew nothing before the first frame (a native crash, a JS error before the first render, or a splash that is never hidden)
entries.fix: Read the process log (iOS: xcrun simctl spawn <udid> log show --last 2m --predicate 'process == "<Executable>"'; Android: adb -s <serial> logcat -d -s ReactNativeJS AndroidRuntime); check the ads app id, the embedded bundle and the startup gate that hides the splash

entries.symptom: The app stays on the splash screen (the screenshot shows only the splash colour)
entries.cause: The startup gate never resolved: a startup step threw or waits forever, so preventAutoHideAsync is never followed by hide
entries.fix: Make every startup step resolve or fail into the startup gate with a timeout, and hide the splash when startup ends (app-startup-and-bootstrap root skeleton)

entries.symptom: The Expo SDK 57 template ships .claude/settings.json enabling an Expo plugin, and its AGENTS.md says npx expo lint
entries.cause: Template defaults for agents; the repo has its own npm scripts and settings
entries.fix: Merge the project settings into that file (never overwrite it); make AGENTS.md name the repo npm scripts (npm run verify, npm run -s check:fast); the developer decides whether the plugin stays

entries.symptom: useIsFocused, a theme or a navigator imported from @react-navigation/* misbehaves in an Expo Router app (wrong context, a second back stack)
entries.cause: expo-router 57 carries its own React Navigation; a direct @react-navigation/* import resolves a second copy with its own contexts
entries.fix: Import navigation hooks and components from expo-router only; React Navigation's static API is the fenced alternative for apps without Expo Router

entries.symptom: Metro fails to bundle import(`./locales/${lang}`)
entries.cause: Metro cannot bundle a dynamic import whose path is a template string
entries.fix: Import each file statically (a map of the known locales or modules)

entries.symptom: A native build fails inside the bundle step (Xcode "Bundle React Native code and images" or Gradle createBundleReleaseJsAndAssets) with a JS error
entries.cause: A JS import or syntax error; the native build only shows the tail of it
entries.fix: Reproduce in seconds with npx expo export --platform ios (or android) and fix the first error it prints
match: Bundle React Native code and images

entries.symptom: Error: Cannot find native module '<Name>' at startup (or in Jest)
entries.cause: The development build was made before the package was installed, or code calls requireNativeModule at import time where the module is optional
entries.fix: Rebuild the development build after adding a native package (Expo Go cannot load it); in your own adapters call requireOptionalNativeModule inside the factory and fall back

entries.symptom: A local Turbo Module or Expo module links on Android but not on iOS
entries.cause: Its podspec sits in ios/ instead of the package root, where Expo autolinking looks for it (read in expo-modules-autolinking 57's iOS resolver)
entries.fix: Move the podspec to the package root (next to package.json), then prebuild with --clean

entries.symptom: TypeError: <module>.<member> is not a function on one platform only
entries.cause: The native module does not implement that member on that platform
entries.fix: Check the member's platform availability in the module's types or docs, guard it with Platform.OS or a capability flag in the adapter, and test both platforms

entries.symptom: npx expo-doctor fails on a package.json script named like a binary (for example "knip")
entries.cause: expo-doctor treats a script named like an installed binary as a conflict
entries.fix: Name the script check:unused (the canonical package scripts do)
